result.summary: The main visual issue is the unlabeled and potentially broken pizza item card at the bottom of the page, which lacks a title, rating, delivery time, or cost information compared to other restaurant cards.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the feed is missing its name, ratings, delivery time, and pricing information, rendering it incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the API successfully fetches and displays the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and delivery fee for this item, consistent with the other displayed cards.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category pill is partially clipped on the right side, suggesting an incomplete horizontal scroll alignment or improper padding.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or horizontal scroll snapping to ensure the last category item is fully visible or provides an indicator that more items are available.
